patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Vonage and Zenzap share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Vonage and Zenzap share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Vonage only if your buying job matches “SMB/mid VoIP business phone (VBC) — Mobile from $13.99/line/mo on 12-month promo; Premium/” rather than Zenzap's shape. Choose Zenzap only if your buying job matches “Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — ” rather than Vonage's shape. Workflow advantage: Vonage leans business-phone, sales-calling; Zenzap leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Vonage and Zenzap share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Vonage is SMB/mid VoIP business phone (VBC) — Mobile from $13.99/line/mo on 12-month promo; Premium/Advanced higher.; Zenzap is Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — free tier, Pro $3/user/month yearly, Business+ $8 .
- Company-size focus: Vonage (solo, small-business, mid-market) vs Zenzap (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Vonage-leaning business-phone, sales-calling vs Zenzap-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Vonage — Taxes and regulatory fees sit on top of published per-line floors; Zenzap — Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+.

Limitations — Vonage: Taxes and regulatory fees sit on top of published per-line floors; Call recording and deeper CRM land on Advanced / Premium packaging; Zenzap: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+; Voice and video calls require Pro; call recording and transcription require Business+.

Poor-fit cases: Vonage is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Taxes and regulatory fees sit on top of published per-line floors · Zenzap is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+ · Avoid Vonage if you actually need Zenzap's motion (Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
